identity.tagline: An AI Company-in-a-Box, rendered as a living 3D office.
identity.northStar: Humans talk in familiar messenger rooms, agents work as visible staff in the Claw3D office, and Mission Control stays the operator governance layer.

lifecycle: Command -> Policy Check -> Runtime Action -> Event(s) -> Persist -> Projection

invariants.statement: The Claw3D-style 3D office is the primary surface (frontstage).
invariants.rationale: Work becomes visible as a spatial office; the app must boot directly into the 3D office, not a console.

invariants.statement: Humans collaborate through a familiar messenger 'human office', not a bespoke operator console.
invariants.rationale: People should not have to learn the platform first; the messenger is where conversation and collaboration live.

invariants.statement: All business state changes flow through Command -> Policy Check -> Runtime Action -> Event(s) -> Persist -> Projection.
invariants.rationale: No surface (3D scene, messenger adapter, runtime worker) may mutate business state directly or bypass policy.

invariants.statement: Mission Control is backstage governance, reached by progressive disclosure — never the landing surface.
invariants.rationale: Operators govern from slide-over sheets layered on top of the office; governance is available, not in the way.

invariants.statement: No 2D-dashboard-first regression: the app must never boot into a 2D dashboard as its main surface.
invariants.rationale: The golden image is an office-first product. A dashboard-first landing page would erase its core identity.

planes.name: Control Plane
planes.role: Command lifecycle, policy decisions, and projections.
mustNotOwn: direct UI mutation of business state

planes.name: Agent Runtime
planes.role: Agent job queue, run lifecycle, tool calls, and streaming output.

planes.name: Human Office / Messenger
planes.role: Messenger channels, threads, and visible human collaboration.

planes.name: Connector Hub
planes.role: Connector manifests and scoped capability grants to customer systems.

planes.name: Data & Policy
planes.role: Append-only events, projections, audit, knowledge graph, and governance gates.

planes.name: Desktop Launcher
planes.role: Install, start/stop, updates, local permissions, and appliance lifecycle.

uxLayers.name: 3D Office (Claw3D)
uxLayers.description: The spatial office where agents work as visible staff. The app boots here.

uxLayers.name: Human Office

uxLayers.name: Mission Control
uxLayers.description: Operator governance — missions, approvals, connectors, knowledge — layered on demand.
